process_policy: observed affinity0-1, nice0; no explicit additional CPU pinning
cpu_percentage_basis: 100 percent equals one logical CPU, per Qeli process; iperf excluded
rss_basis: maximum sampled resident set in KiB, not kernel high-watermark
percentile_method: nearest-rank per window; median/min/max across three fresh sessions; lost probes have no fabricated RTT
initial_failure: ValueError: ping population truncated or invalid
resume_failure: RuntimeError: RTT probes outside conservative load interval

attempt2_udp_awg_p1.refusal: RTT probes outside conservative load interval

post_measurement_command_quoting.difference: Only shell quoting of ping/iperf IP arguments, with CRLF/LF normalization; commands identical for all three measured IPv4 targets

synchronization_methods.initial_complete_direct: dispatch+2s, iputils -c/-w, both actual populations sent exactly200 with zero loss
synchronization_methods.resume_non_direct: dispatch+2s, fixed200 sends with external timeout
synchronization_methods.final_method: TCP established then2s, fixed200 sends with external timeout
synchronization_methods.all_admitted: every received reply is inside rounded iperf start+1 to start+10; exact per-window offsets retained

limits: Unpaced TCP bidir is the maximum offered load profile; physical link and both VM CPUs saturation are not established
No one-way, IPv6 latency, UDP payload latency or auth-rate claims
No latency regression threshold or universal performance PASS
Only received replies form RTT population; loss retained separately
200 probes per window are not a long-duration tail guarantee
Probe synchronization changed after harness refusals; actual overlap offsets retained, no latency regression inference
Namespace kernel counters are not per-socket drop attribution
